integrity: All-n proof is independent of bounded exact-arithmetic checks; no external certification or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to symmetric simple nearest-neighbor random bridges of prescribed even length.
Couples excursion lengths, not full trajectories, excursion signs, or heights.
The conditioned Catalan law and several scalar excursion-moment results are earlier mathematics.
Broader fragmentation literature has not been exhaustively eliminated; independent priority assessment has not been performed.
title: An exact cyclic fragmentation of conditioned random-walk excursion lengths
